Report_ID: All-cause death during 90 days of follow-up
Title: A prospective, randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind trial about safety and efficacy of combined treatment with alteplase (rt-PA) and Cerebrolysin in acute ischaemic hemispheric stroke
Author: Wilfried Lang, Christian H. Stadler, Zdravka Poljakovic, David Fleet, and the Lyse Study Group
Comment: The paper reports no mortality risk ratio or confidence interval, so only the directly reported event counts and safety/randomized denominators were extracted. The Results state that all 119 randomized participants received study medication and were included in the ITT/safety population; therefore mortality is 4/60 versus 4/59 at 90 days.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Alteplase (rt-PA) plus Cerebrolysin 30 ml/day IV for 10 consecutive days') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Design Type: Prospective, randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind, parallel-group trial
Content length: 10 consecutive days of study treatment; 90 days of follow-up
Participant type: Adults aged 18–80 years with acute ischaemic hemispheric stroke
Outcome measurement: Death recorded as a safety endpoint over 90 days of follow-up
Outcome variable: All-cause death during 90 days of follow-up

Title: Cerebrolysin effects on neurological outcomes and cerebral blood flow in acute ischemic stroke
Author: Mohammad Reza Amiri-Nikpour et al.
Comment: The trial followed efficacy outcomes through day 90, but mortality was reported only as occurring before day 30. No day-90 mortality count was explicitly stated. Randomized denominators (23 per arm) were used because the deaths were excluded from the final 90-day efficacy analysis. The paper did not report an RR, so no RR was entered.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Cerebrolysin 30 mL intravenously once daily for 10 days plus aspirin 100 mg daily') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Design Type: Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled parallel-group clinical trial
Study Environment: Hospital; Imam Khomeini Hospital, Urmia University of Medical Sciences
Topic of Content: Cerebrolysin for acute focal ischemic stroke
Participant type: Adults with acute focal ischemic stroke
Recruitment source: Consecutive patients with suspected brain stroke assessed at Imam Khomeini Hospital
Outcome measurement: Number of participants who died before day 30

Title: Neuroprotective treatment with Cerebrolysin in patients with acute stroke: a randomised controlled trial
Author: G. Ladurner, P. Kalvach, H. Moessler, and the Cerebrolysin Study Group
Comment: The paper reports arm-level deaths and percentages but no risk ratio or confidence interval. Denominators are the randomized safety population, explicitly stated to include all randomized patients. Mortality occurred during the study whose final visit was day 90.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Cerebrolysin 50 mL/day IV for 21 days plus aspirin and pentoxifylline') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Study Environment: Multicentre clinical trial at eight investigational sites
Content length: 21 days of treatment with follow-up to day 90
Topic of Content: Cerebrolysin treatment in acute ischaemic stroke
Participant type: Adults aged 45–85 years with first acute ischaemic stroke
Recruitment source: Eight investigational sites in Austria, Czech Republic, and Hungary
Outcome measurement: Number of participants who died from any cause during the study

Title: Cerebrolysin in Patients With Acute Ischemic Stroke in Asia Results of a Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Randomized Trial
Author: Heiss et al.
Comment: Randomized denominators were used as prespecified: 529 Cerebrolysin and 541 placebo. The safety-evaluable placebo denominator was 540 because one randomized placebo participant was untreated. The paper reports a hazard ratio of 1.26 oriented so that values above 1 favor Cerebrolysin; it is not the requested Cerebrolysin-versus-placebo risk ratio. No risk ratio was recorded because the paper did not report one verbatim. The reported 6.6% placebo cumulative Kaplan-Meier mortality does not equal 32/541 and was therefore not entered as a raw arm percentage.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Cerebrolysin 30 mL daily for 10 days plus aspirin') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Design Type: Phase IV multicenter randomized double-blind placebo-controlled parallel-group trial
Country: China, Hong Kong, South Korea, and Myanmar
Content length: 10 days of treatment; follow-up to 90 days
Topic of Content: Cerebrolysin treatment for acute ischaemic stroke
Participant type: Adults aged 18–85 years with acute hemispheric ischaemic stroke
Recruitment source: 51 centers in China, Hong Kong, South Korea, and Myanmar
Outcome measurement: Death from any cause by Day 90
